note: Oman, read on 2026-10-30 and again on 2026-11-03 in the Spanish Embassy in Muscat's page on working in Oman (exteriores.gob.es, undated; a secondary source), and on 2026-11-03 in the Royal Oman Police's own pages on visas and the resident card (rop.gov.om reset the connection, so they were read in Common Crawl's capture of 10 October 2026). The work visa is granted at an employer's request and on its responsibility to a foreigner coming to Oman for employment, with the Ministry of Manpower's labour permit unless a government body invites them; it is valid for staying two years from its stamping (a two-year term), its worker at least 21, its fee 20 (the page names no currency; the rial is read). The embassy adds that the worker may work only for the sponsor (work for the sponsor) and that the law makes changing sponsor difficult. Every resident must obtain a resident card within 30 days of entry, at 6 for one year or 11 for two, a further fee not added to the visa's. A non-working partner gets a residence permit only if married, on an apostilled translated marriage certificate (the embassy); the police list it as the Family Joining Visa, whose terms weren't in the capture read. Until 2026-11-03 the routes carried the embassy's Spanish names and no term or fee. Renewal, decision times, where each is applied for, permanent residence and naturalisation aren't stated.

sources.title: Embajada de España en Mascate, Trabajar (Permisos de residencia y trabajo)
sources.said: Los extranjeros que quieran residir y trabajar en Omán necesitan que alguna empresa establecida en Omán o un nacional omaní haga de “sponsor”. Sólo se puede trabajar para el “sponsor”, que es quien se encarga de los trámites de obtención del visado y permiso de residencia ante las autoridades omaníes. ... La ley dificulta el cambio de “sponsor” por lo que es complicado cambiar de trabajo. ... En el caso de parejas, para que las autoridades omaníes concedan un permiso de residencia al miembro de la pareja que no trabaja, deben estar casados y aportar un certificado de matrimonio traducido y apostillado

sources.title: Royal Oman Police, Visas: Work Visa (Common Crawl CC-MAIN-2026-43 capture of 2026-10-10)
sources.said: Work Visa Description It is granted at the request and on the responsibility of an employer to a foreigner who is coming to Oman for employment. Unless the foreigner is invited by a government organization a labour permit from the Ministry of Manpower is needed. The visa is valid for staying in the country for 2 years as of the date of stamping on the passport. Multi-entry visa. Requirements The sponsor must be a local one with full legal competence. ... The person for whom the work visa is requested shall not be below 21. ... Fees Twenty (20) . N.B. A fine of 50 per month will be charged for delay in the renewal.

sources.title: Royal Oman Police, Resident Card (Common Crawl CC-MAIN-2026-43 capture of 2026-10-10)
sources.said: Every expatriate who is resident in Oman must obtain a Residence Card within 30 days from the date of entry in Oman. ... Fees 6 for one year. 11 for two years. 10 for each month of delay in application for the card.
